test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

“Put this suitcase in the first class compartment,” said Mr. Dey to the porter.

options.text: Mr. Dey told the porter to put that suitcase in the first class compartment.
Mr. Dey requested the porter to put that suitcase in the first class compartment.
Mr. Dey asked the porter to put this suitcase in the first class compartment.
Mr. Dey told the porter that he should put that suitcase in the first class compartment.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Mr. Dey told the porter to put that suitcase in the first class compartment. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'told'
 
• '**This**' in the direct speech changes to '**that**' in the indirect speech. 
 
• The inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the preposition 'to' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

The indirect sentence is: *Mr. Dey told the porter to put that suitcase in the first class compartment. *
